posts.title: 2026 palette
posts.description:
Early in 2026 I bought this square picture frame with glass front, I inserted grey card behind the glass and this become an ideal trusty palette which I’ve used right through 2026.
I’ve decided it’s now time to abandon this and move onto a fresh version.
But I think it’s intriguing to see the used palette like this with the paint and texture used. It’s become an art form in its own right.
